answers.description: Reference-free Qwen 3.6 (Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) WITHOUT reasoning enabled. The null task2_pred scores are imputed using the mean score of the same MT system across all non-null segments in the same language pair, falling back to that system's global mean across all pairs, and finally to the dataset-wide mean if no non-null scores exist for that system.
answers.name: Qwen 3.6 - No Reasoning Baseline
